headline: EPS dips q/q but is up year-over-year
summary_short: Sumber Alfaria Trijaya reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of Rp23.11, down 11.5% q/q but up 5.6% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of Rp23.11 fell 11.5% sequentially from Rp26.12 but rose 5.6% year-over-year from Rp21.89. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
